# Cineplay

> Cineplay is a high-speed cinema and television series discovery and streaming platform offering 1080p and 4K media streaming, comprehensive TMDB metadata, episode guides, and AI search engine integration.

## Main Pages & Search Routes
- [Homepage](https://cineplay.online): Access the main cinema portal, featured releases, and trending titles.
- [Browse Catalog](https://cineplay.online/browse): Explore movies and TV series filtered by genre, release year, and rating.
- [Search Engine](https://cineplay.online/search): Real-time instant search across movies, TV series, actors, and directors.
- [Movies Library](https://cineplay.online/movies): Trending, popular, and top-rated movies collection.
- [TV Series Library](https://cineplay.online/series): Popular TV series, season guides, and episode listings.
- [AI Search Index API](https://cineplay.online/api/ai-search): High-speed structured AI Search & RAG indexing API.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://cineplay.online/llms-full.txt): Extended machine-readable knowledge base for LLM web crawlers.
- [XML Sitemap](https://cineplay.online/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap listing canonical routes and media pages.

## Developer & AI API Endpoints
- [AI Search Indexing Endpoint](https://cineplay.online/api/ai-search): RAG entity search endpoint formatted for SearchGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and ChatGPT.
- [TMDB Movie Details API Endpoint](https://cineplay.online/api/tmdb/movie/550): Detailed movie metadata, cast, crew, and video trailers.
- [TMDB TV Details API Endpoint](https://cineplay.online/api/tmdb/tv/1399): Full TV show metadata, season breakdowns, and video trailers.
- [TMDB Trending API Endpoint](https://cineplay.online/api/tmdb/trending/all/day): Daily trending movies and TV series dataset.
- [TMDB Search API Endpoint](https://cineplay.online/api/tmdb/search/multi?query=Inception): Unified multi-media search endpoint.

## Network Mirrors & Sister Sites
- [Cinejoy Online](https://cinejoy.online/): High-speed official partner mirror and streaming node.
- [Cineplay Ink](https://cineplay.ink): Primary domain mirror.
- [Cineplay Online](https://cineplay.online): Backup streaming portal.
- [Flixer Ink](https://flixer.ink): Sister network stream mirror.
- [Cineby AT](https://cineby.at): European mirror node.
- [Cineby Mom](https://cineby.mom): Global mirror node.
- [Bitcine Online](https://bitcine.online): High-speed backup stream node.
